snippet.title: The Cave Diver - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist The Cave Diver On Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3004390/The_Cave_Diver/

Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure game. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

The suffocating rocks of the caves are slowly closing in to claim another soul.

Keep crawling...

Eventually, a passageway has to open up...

Game by Ovsko: https://x.com/ovsko

Trailer Audio Mix by tttlllrrr: https://soundcloud.com/taylorshechet
Game Cover Art by Artyom Trakhanov: https://x.com/vor_bokor
